result.summary: Found 1 major visual defect: overlapping metadata text in the “Popular right now” restaurant card makes delivery time/fee unreadable. Edge-clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff were excluded as requested.

issues.description: Under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar”, the metadata line appears to overlap/collide: the ETA, “€0 delivery”, and category text are rendered on top of each other, producing garbled text such as “25–30…€0 delivery”.
issues.suggestion: Rework the card metadata row to use a single horizontal flow with proper spacing/constraints; avoid absolute positioning or duplicated labels, and ensure ETA, delivery fee, and cuisine are separated with clear delimiters.
